parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more specific, actionable guidance with concrete dollar amounts, ticker suggestions (VTI, VBIAX), and importantly addresses debt reduction which is critical given the user's negative net worth. While System A has slightly better risk alignment (correctly labeling VTTSX-related recs as low rather than moderate) and marginally better grounding (B slightly miscalculates the 6-month expense figure), B's broader coverage of the user's actual financial situation—especially the debt issue—makes it more useful overall.
